source.title: 上海市建筑标准设计《先张法预应力混凝土空心板（桥梁）》（征求意见稿）DBJT08-101-20xx，图集号 2021沪G1005
source.title_en: Shanghai building standard design: pretensioned prestressed concrete hollow slabs (bridges), consultation draft revising DBJT08-101-2015
source.publisher: 上海市住房和城乡建设管理委员会 / 上海市交通委员会; 主编 上海市政工程设计研究总院（集团）有限公司
source.status: 征求意见稿 (consultation draft), PDF created 2021-10-19; the issued edition is DBJT 08-101-2024 (effective 2024-02-01), not held. Draft dimensions may differ from the issued atlas.
source.units: mm (drawings); published section properties in m, m2, m4, m3
source.drawing_type: vector CAD (no raster images on section pages); dimensions read visually from 300-800 dpi renders

common_dimensions_mm.crossfall: 2% across the top (rising to the right as drawn); depth D printed at the base centreline
common_dimensions_mm.edge_cantilever: tip thickness 200; cantilever soffit rises 50 over 300; root height D-267 (printed 283/383/583/683)

geometry_notes: Midspan section B-B only; the support section A-A (narrower top, cast with the end diaphragm) and end plugs are excluded.

The top surface follows the printed 2% crossfall about the base centreline: y = D + 0.02 x. The drawn section is therefore asymmetric (left ledge D-193, right D-167); a slab laid with the opposite fall is the mirror image.
Ledges are horizontal at the printed heights; the 50 mm overhang faces run straight from the ledge corner (x = +/-650) to the top corner (x = +/-600).
R30 reentrant fillets are modelled as exact tangent arcs (convention: tangent to web face and ledge).

Void vertical position is fixed by the printed bottom cover (90/140/100/150). The printed top covers (100/150/100/150) are measured at the void centreline x = -225 and close only approximately against the 2% crossfall (-4.5 mm); the bottom cover is used.
Edge-slab drip groove (滴水槽, R10 at 100 mm from the cantilever tip) is omitted (about 157 mm2).
No section-property table is printed for volume 1; checks are analytic only.

hinged.family: 第二分册：铰接空心板（桥梁） hinge-jointed hollow slabs, spans 10/13/16/18/20/22 m, loads 城-B/公路-II; restricted by the draft to low-grade roads and replacement of existing slabs

locators.joint_detail: 铰缝 detail on each sheet: top opening 20+70+20, bottom 50+10+50 (10 mm gap)

sections.16-18m-middle: PDF p144 = printed 19 (18 m sheet printed 21 shares the property row)
sections.20-22m-middle: PDF p148 = printed 23 (22 m sheet printed 25 shares the property row)

common_dimensions_mm.shear_key: from the top: 20 vertical at 30 inset, sloping to the deepest point (inset 50, or 60 for 900 deep) over the next k, back to the full face over another k; k = 70 (520/620/820), 80 (900)
common_dimensions_mm.edge_cantilever: 400 wide; tip thickness 200; soffit rises 50 over 400; root height D-250 (270/370/570/650)

published_properties_m.note: Ys = centroid to top, Yx = centroid to soffit. The separate middle-slab column with 80 mm topping (A 0.39042/0.48942/0.46912/0.54542, I 0.01568/0.02431/0.04540/0.06376) is composite and not used.

residuals_vs_published.method: exact polygon with 720-point voids, holes subtracted

geometry_notes: Top surface is flat (no crossfall) on the volume 2 sections.

The 50/60 mm dimension beside the key is the horizontal inset of the deepest key point; this reading, the 30 mm top inset and the 20/k/k vertical chain reproduce all eight published areas to <=0.004%, centroids to <=0.002% and inertias to <=0.036% (the published I is rounded to 3 significant figures for 10 m).
Voids: circles R180, or round-ended 360 x 650 (R180 + 290 straight + R180), at the printed bottom covers.
Edge-slab drip groove (滴水槽 R10) is omitted; the published area matches only without it.
Cross-section is uniform over the slab (no midspan/support distinction on these sheets); end plugs excluded.
